title: Extreme Disk Access AFTER Loading Godot Editor or Running a Godot Project
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproduceable In: v4.6.1.stable.steam [14d19694e]

### System information

Windows 11 - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 - AMD Ryzen 9 5900X 12/24-Core Processor - 32 GB RAM - 2 TB Samsung EVO SSD

### Issue description

I don’t know when this started but I’ve been noticing for awhile now that whenever I load the Godot Editor or run a project from within the Godot Editor, as soon as the editor finishes loading or my project finishes loading and is now running, my SSD read access immediately gets pegged up to nearly 100% usage for a solid minute straight, reporting over 400 MB/sec of reading, then drops back down to nothing.

Again, this happens AFTER the editor finishes loading or AFTER a project has finished loading and has begun running. While this extreme read access is happening everything still works as intended without lag or interruptions.

Also, it only happens on the drive the Godot Editor and my projects are stored on. I have a second SSD which I use strictly for backup purposes and it shows no activity at all while this is happening. Curiously, it does NOT happen with the project load screen when your first boot the Editor, you have to actually load a project first.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the Godot Editor and load any project.
2. Wait until the Editor finishes loading and watch disk usage skyrocket following.
3. Wait a minute or so and the disk usage returns to normal.
4. Alternatively, run a project from within the Godot Editor and this happens again once the project is doing loading and is now running.
